ayahOccurrences.text: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ آثَارِهِمْ إِن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَلَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ عَلَىٰٓ آثَارِهِمْ إِن لَّمْ يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَسَفًا

ayahOccurrences.text: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: بَٰخِعٌ is in the derivative form: بَاخِعٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ب/خ/ع   b–kh–ʿ tendon that runs close to the neck, to cut such tendon, to cut the throat; to show humility; to be docile. Of this root, بَاخِعٌ bākhiʿ occurs 2 times in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
بَاخِعٌ bākhiʿ [act. part.] tormenting, killing (oneself with sorrow or worry)

(26:3) فلعَلَّكَ بَاخِعٌ نَفْسَكَ أَلاَّ يَكُونُوا مُؤْمِنِينَ it may be that you [Prophet] are going to kill yourself [with worry] because they will not become believers!
